description: RAPID: Tornado Damage to Steel Structures, Pampa, TX (November 2015) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Arn Womble, Insurance Institute for Business & Home Safety (ibhs.org). On November 16-17, 2015, an unusual and intense late-season tornado outbreak severely damaged a group of engineered structures at the Halliburton Oilfield Services facility east of Pampa, TX, as well as several nearby center-pivot irrigation ("agricultural sprinkler") systems. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2HX23. Keywords: tornado, lidar, UAS, satellite, remote sensing. Published 2018-07-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
